### `r paste0(toupper(watershed), " watershed with ", toupper(model), " and version ", medfateland_version)`

#### Goodness-of-fit

```{r, echo = FALSE}
Q_daily_cal <- Q_daily |>
  dplyr::filter(Date >= options$calibration_start,
         Date <= options$calibration_end)
Q_daily_eval <- Q_daily |>
  dplyr::filter(Date > options$calibration_end)
Q_monthly_cal <- Q_monthly |>
  dplyr::filter(Date >= options$calibration_start,
         Date <= options$calibration_end)
Q_monthly_eval <- Q_monthly |>
  dplyr::filter(Date > options$calibration_end)
```

KGE_daily_cal_growth<-hydroGOF::KGE(Q_daily_cal$Qcal_growth,Q_daily_cal$Qobs, s=c(1,1,1), na.rm=TRUE, method=c("2021"),

# Monthly KGE

KGE_monthly_cal_growth<-hydroGOF::KGE(Q_monthly_cal$Qcal_growth,Q_monthly_cal$Qobs, s=c(1,1,1), na.rm=TRUE, method=c("2021"),

# Index of agreement
d_daily_cal_spwb<-hydroGOF::dr(Q_daily_cal$Qcal_spwb,Q_daily_cal$Qobs, na.rm = TRUE)
d_daily_cal_growth<-hydroGOF::dr(Q_daily_cal$Qcal_growth,Q_daily_cal$Qobs, na.rm = TRUE)

# RMSE
rmse_daily_cal_spwb<-hydroGOF::rmse(Q_daily_cal$Qcal_spwb,Q_daily_cal$Qobs, na.rm=TRUE, fun=NULL,
                       epsilon.type=c("none"), epsilon.value=NA)
rmse_daily_cal_growth<-hydroGOF::rmse(Q_daily_cal$Qcal_growth,Q_daily_cal$Qobs, na.rm=TRUE, fun=NULL,

validation_coefficients<- data.frame(Scale = c("Daily", "Daily", "Daily","Daily","Monthly", "Monthly", "Monthly", "Monthly"),

                                     Model = c("spwb", "growth", "spwb", "growth","spwb", "growth", "spwb", "growth"),

validation_coefficients$VE[1]<-round(ve_daily_cal_spwb,3)

#### Time series

*Daily*

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig = TRUE, fig.width=8, fig.height = 6, warning=FALSE}
p1 <-ggplot(Q_daily |>
         dplyr::rename(Observed = Qobs,
                       Predicted = Qcal_spwb) |>
         tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("Observed", "Predicted"), names_to = "type", values_to = "Q") 
       , aes(x=Date))+
  geom_line(aes(y = Q, col = type), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date(options$calibration_end), col = "darkgray", linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_y_continuous("Q (m3/s)")+
  scale_color_discrete(NULL, palette = c("black", "blue"))+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(subtitle = "spwb vs. observed")+
  theme(legend.position = c(0.1,0.85), legend.background = element_blank())
p2<-ggplot(Q_daily |>
         dplyr::rename(Observed = Qobs,
                       Predicted = Qcal_growth) |>
         tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("Observed", "Predicted"), names_to = "type", values_to = "Q") 
       , aes(x=Date))+
  geom_line(aes(y = Q, col = type), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date(options$calibration_end), col = "darkgray", linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_y_continuous("Q (m3/s)")+
  scale_color_discrete(NULL, palette = c("black", "green"))+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(subtitle = "growth vs. observed")+
  theme(legend.position = c(0.1,0.85), legend.background = element_blank())
cowplot::plot_grid(p1, p2, nrow=2)
```

*Monthly*

#### Hydrological analysis (daily scale)

*Density distribution*

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig = TRUE, fig.width=8, fig.height = 3, warning=FALSE}
g1<-ggplot(Q_daily_cal) +
  geom_density(aes(x=Qobs), col="black", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_density(aes(x=Qcal_spwb), col="blue", alpha = 0.8)+
  geom_density(aes(x=Qcal_growth), col="green", alpha = 0.8)+
  scale_x_continuous("Daily Q (m3/s)", transform = "log10")+
  labs(subtitle = "Calibration period")+
  theme_bw()
g2<-ggplot(Q_daily_eval) +
  geom_density(aes(x=Qobs), col="black", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_density(aes(x=Qcal_spwb), col="blue", alpha = 0.8)+
  geom_density(aes(x=Qcal_growth), col="green", alpha = 0.8)+
  scale_x_continuous("Daily Q (m3/s)", transform = "log10")+
  labs(subtitle = "Evaluation period")+
  theme_bw()
cowplot::plot_grid(g1, g2, ncol = 2)
```

*Percentiles*

```{r, echo = FALSE}
p = c(0.01,0.05,0.10,0.15,0.25,0.50,0.75,0.85,0.90,0.95, 0.99)
perc_df <- data.frame("Observed/calibration" = round(quantile(Q_daily_cal$Qobs, probs = p, na.rm=TRUE),5),
                      "spwb/calibration" = round(quantile(Q_daily_cal$Qcal_spwb, probs = p, na.rm=TRUE),5),
                      "growth/calibration" = round(quantile(Q_daily_cal$Qcal_growth, probs = p, na.rm=TRUE),5),
                      "Observed/Evaluation" = round(quantile(Q_daily_eval$Qobs, probs = p, na.rm=TRUE),5),
                      "spwb/Evaluation" = round(quantile(Q_daily_eval$Qcal_spwb, probs = p, na.rm=TRUE),5),
                      "growth/Evaluation" = round(quantile(Q_daily_eval$Qcal_growth, probs = p, na.rm=TRUE),5))
perc_df |> 
  kbl() |>
  kable_styling()
```
